facts.fact: The paper titled 'Can Hiccup Supply Enough Fish to Maintain a Dragon's Diet?' was authored by Amal Doua from The Centre for Interdisciplinary Science, University of Leicester.
In the paper, it is stated that Toothless, a Night Fury dragon, would have required 13 Icelandic cod and 56 Atlantic salmon daily while trapped for twelve days, totaling 716 kg of fish.
Hiccup would have needed to carry a total of 828 fish weighing 8592 kg over the twelve days, which is deemed unrealistic given his physical capabilities.
The paper was published in the Journal of Interdisciplinary Science Topics on March 31, 2017.

result.summary: The paper 'Can Hiccup Supply Enough Fish to Maintain a Dragon's Diet?' by Amal Doua analyzes the dietary needs of Toothless, a dragon from the How to Train Your Dragon franchise, and concludes that the amount of fish required for his sustenance is impractical for Hiccup to supply.

raw_results.content: Journal of Interdisciplinary Science Topics Can Hiccup Supply Enough Fish to Maintain a Dragon’s Diet? Amal Doua The Centre for Interdisciplinary Science, University of Leicester 31/03/2017 Abstract Toothless is a Night Fury dragon who appears in the How to Train Your Dragon (HTTYD) franchise, and is said to be the rarest, fastest, and most intelligent of the dragon species. In the 2010 film, Toothless is struck down during a dragon raid and loses his left tail-fin, leaving him trapped in a sunken area. This paper investigates the feasibility of Hiccup, a teenage boy, being able to supply enough fish to maintain the dragon’s diet by catching and bringing fish to him. It was found that in the twelve days that Toothless was trapped, he would have required 13 Icelandic cod and 56 Atlantic [...] lapse montages in the film, it is taken that Toothless is in The Cove for a total of twelve days . It is assumed that Hiccup visited once a day for the duration of Toothless’ stay. On the third day, Hiccup brings a sack of fish, and mentions that it contains Icelandic cod and salmon. There is also a pond in the clearing, and one scene shows Toothless hunting for fish. However, in this paper, it is assumed that Toothless relies solely on Hiccup for nutrition. During his time in The Cove, it is assumed that his diet consists of only salmon and cod. It is also assumed that each sack contained the same amount of fish, and that he received the same amount every day for twelve days. The sack is modelled as a cylinder, while the fish have been modelled as prolate spheroids (see Appendix for [...] hold 56 Atlantic salmon and 13 Icelandic cod. Hiccup would have to carry 716 kg of fish to The Cove every day, a total of 8592 kg over the period of twelve days. Hiccup is depicted as physically weak, and is unable to even hold up a shield for a prolonged time. It is therefore concluded that Hiccup would be unable to carry the bag and could not feed Toothless for the duration of his time in The Cove, unless he made several trips, used less heavy fish, or didn’t fully fill the sack.
